module.publicSeam: ic-card, ic-divider, ic-list, ic-table and ic-media-container custom elements, native platform/ARIA behavior, and central --ui-* Tokens
module.adapter: Vendor elements, private DOM, events and custom properties remain replaceable inside the implementation.
module.responsibility: Own generic grouping, separation and data presentation structure while callers retain business meaning, data operations and domain state.

contract.note: 同意 Containers/Data 判断 1–10，并确认 25 个通用 Legacy 映射；31 个领域实例保持原处置。
contract.evidence: User explicitly replied ‘同意 开始开发’ after reviewing the ten enumerated judgments and Legacy mapping.

migration.evidence: Second human Gate approved Containers/Data migration eligibility; no business page migration was performed.

legacyCoverage.rule: Legacy evidence proves coverage and demand, not target appearance. Media and workflow/node cards retain their domain dispositions and are not silently remapped to a generic container.

judgments: Card is a generic non-interactive grouping surface; selection belongs to an owned Selection/Adjustment control or a separately confirmed selectable pattern.
Divider separates adjacent groups and never substitutes for spacing, a heading or a status boundary.
List owns repeated-item structure only; commands, selection and navigation retain their confirmed component semantics.
Table is for comparable labeled columns, not responsive page layout, property forms or arbitrary card grids.
Media Container owns aspect, fit, placeholder and caption structure but no Generation Output, Node, workflow or Asset Library behavior.
Card and Media Container may compose; neither may absorb Dialog, Alert, Menu, Toolbar, Tabs or domain state.
Card exposes an explicit Small, Medium or Large padding size independent of inherited page density; Medium is the backward-compatible default.
Table exposes an explicit Small, Medium or Large spacing size independent of inherited page density; Medium is the backward-compatible default.
Interactive descendants keep native tab order; containers do not create roving focus or make the whole surface clickable.
Narrow layouts reflow Card regions, List metadata and Table presentation without truncating meaning or changing reading order.
Invalid semantic combinations fail closed through the public ic-contract-error state after Contract confirmation.

Container motion remains deliberately sparse: Card, Divider, List and Media Container are stable structure and do not add family-level entrance, hover lift or layout movement. Table retains only its existing fast row background transition for hover and selection feedback, with Reduced Motion inherited from central duration Tokens.

components.purpose: Group reusable non-domain content into one bounded surface.
useWhen: Related heading, body and optional actions need one reusable visual group.
A settings or content section benefits from surface separation.
prohibitedUses: clickable choice without an explicit selection control
Node, workflow or Generation Output card

presentation.contentGapOverride: --ic-card-content-gap may be set to 0 or another spacing value for specialized body layouts
presentation.optionalRegions: unassigned header and footer slots render no box or spacing

actionLayout.wrapping: Actions wrap only when their visible labels cannot fit; content and headings retain start alignment.
actionLayout.rule: Footer actions default to the reading-direction inline end without making the Card itself interactive.

components.purpose: Separate adjacent content groups without creating a surface or focus stop.
useWhen: Two adjacent groups need a perceivable structural separator.

components.purpose: Present a labeled ordered or unordered collection with consistent item structure.
useWhen: Repeated items share one reading and metadata pattern.
DOM order is the meaningful reading order.

components.purpose: Present labeled rows whose values are meaningfully comparable across stable columns.
useWhen: Users compare values vertically or horizontally.
Column headers remain meaningful for every row.

presentation.motion: Body-row cell background changes use --ui-motion-duration-fast; table geometry, row position and container elevation do not animate. Reduced Motion resolves the shared duration to 1ms.
presentation.rule: Table size is selected with size=small|medium|large and does not change implicitly with page density.

components.purpose: Frame image, video, audio or file preview content with stable fit, aspect and fallback structure.
useWhen: A reusable surface needs predictable media sizing and fallback.
Caption or accessible media labeling belongs next to the preview.

presentation.rule: Audio does not receive the generic visual preview frame; its native control and caption provide the visible structure.

density.rule: Density remains inherited for List and compact media collections. Card and Table sizing are selected explicitly with size=small|medium|large and do not change implicitly with page density.

keyboard.containers: Card, Divider and Media Container add no focus stop; interactive descendants remain in native DOM order.
keyboard.list: List adds no composite keyboard scope; owned controls retain their confirmed keyboard behavior.
keyboard.table: Tab reaches interactive cell content in DOM order; row selection uses explicit Selection/Adjustment controls. Arrow-key grid behavior is out of scope unless a later editable-grid contract is approved.

accessibility.card: A Card uses a labeled region only when its grouping needs an accessible landmark; otherwise it remains neutral structure.
accessibility.divider: Divider exposes separator semantics and orientation but is not focusable.
accessibility.list: Native list semantics and one accessible label preserve item count and order.
accessibility.table: The required ic-table label supplies the native table's accessible name when a visible caption is absent; native headers preserve data relationships in responsive presentation.
accessibility.mediaContainer: The caller supplies the media alternative or accessible label; loading and unavailable states use the confirmed Feedback/Progress status/alert semantics without duplicating them.

runtimeContract.engineBoundary: Business and acceptance sources consume only ic-* tags, native platform/ARIA behavior and central --ui-* Tokens.
